'''Mark Zoran'''<ref name="dt-21412">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21412 An endor Ops FastBall], DeckTech (Mark "Ar2Dee2" Zoran, 13 February 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21412/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21412/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015153745/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21412/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech and Game Players Network handle '''Ar2Dee2'''<ref name="gpn-82">[https://web.archive.org/web/20051102154456/http://gameplayersnetwork.com/card/decks.asp?gm=starwars&id=82 Revenge of the Hutt], Game Players Network (ar2dee2, 5 December 2001), Wayback Machine copy.</ref>) posted a [[Dark]] [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]] list on DeckTech in February 2002. Zoran also published twelve constructed lists on [[Game Players Network]] in December 2001.
